name: Niku Steakhouse
bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Tables open 30 days ahead; for dates inside that, call or check OpenTable.
cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead; later cancellations, no-shows and guests dropped after the 24-hour confirmation are charged $50 a person. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
walkIns: Walk-ins are taken when there's room; the bar counter serves the full dinner menu, first come, first served.
groups: Main dining room tables seat up to six. The private dining room takes 7 to 14 guests with a four- or five-course tasting menu, and the whole restaurant can be booked for 65 seated or 85 standing.
dressCode: No dress code ('come as you are'), though many guests dress smartly.
children: Children are welcome if they can stay seated through the meal and must be counted in the party. No children under seven at the bar or high-top tables; high chairs available, no space for prams or car seats.
duration: At least two hours for two people, and about 30 minutes more for each extra guest.
byob: Corkage is $80 a 750ml bottle (up to two) or $160 a magnum (one), for wines not on the list. Outside celebration cakes cost $6 a person.
